scope_note: Programme-specific pathways from official public SNU pages and prospectuses. A research area, elective focus, stream, or partner route is not labelled as an award-bearing specialisation unless the source does so.

accelerated-masters-program-with-asu.label: ASU master's route
accelerated-masters-program-with-asu.summary: The public programme page identifies the accelerated ASU route and specifically names MS Software Engineering with a Cybersecurity specialization; exact destination eligibility is partner- and cohort-dependent.

b-a-research-in-english.label: English major
b-a-research-in-english.summary: The public programme page describes a single English major and does not publish separate award-bearing specialisation buckets. Use the degree audit and current electives instead.

b-sc-research-in-biotechnology.summary: The public programme page does not publish separate award-bearing specialisation buckets for this degree.

b-sc-research-in-chemistry.label: Major configuration
b-sc-research-in-chemistry.summary: The official overview says a Chemistry major may be combined with a Life Sciences minor, or pursued with a specialization in Chemical Physics or Chemical Biology. Public credit-bucket rules are not stated on that page.

b-sc-research-in-economics.summary: The public programme page does not publish separate award-bearing specialisation buckets for this degree.

b-tech-in-civil-engineering.label: Optional specialisation
b-tech-in-civil-engineering.summary: Civil Engineering publishes three optional specialisations. The 2024 prospectus requires at least three courses (minimum 9 elective credits) plus the 6-credit seventh-semester FYUP project in the same area, for 15 credits total.

b-tech-in-computer-science-and-engineeri.label: Optional specialisation
b-tech-in-computer-science-and-engineeri.summary: CSE publishes three optional specialisations. Complete 12 bucket credits, or 6 bucket credits plus the 6-credit Project-I in the same area; overall CGPA must be at least 7 and the specialisation-component CGPA at least 8. Only one may be claimed.
b-tech-in-computer-science-and-engineeri.cohort_note: 2022 onward prospectus; course lists are marked tentative by SNU

options.title: Data Science and Big Data Analytics

b-tech-in-electrical-and-computer-engine.label: Optional specialisation
b-tech-in-electrical-and-computer-engine.summary: The current curriculum publishes three departmental and four interdisciplinary specialisations. Each needs at least 12 credits from its pool and CGPA of at least 5; some interdisciplinary tracks also name prerequisites or compulsory courses.
b-tech-in-electrical-and-computer-engine.cohort_note: Current public curriculum; verify cohort applicability

b-tech-in-mechanical-engineering.label: Optional track
b-tech-in-mechanical-engineering.summary: The 2025-29-onward curriculum publishes three departmental and two interdisciplinary tracks. A track uses 12 major-elective credits and is optional.

ba-research-in-international-relations.label: International Relations major
ba-research-in-international-relations.summary: The public programme page does not publish separate award-bearing specialisation buckets for this degree.

ba-research-interdisciplinary-humanities.label: Interdisciplinary major
ba-research-interdisciplinary-humanities.summary: After the common first year, students choose one of three published interdisciplinary areas. The programme structure describes each as a 60-credit major within the 160-credit degree.

bachelor-of-design.label: B.Des. stream
bachelor-of-design.summary: The official overview describes a choice-based streaming system for the B.Des. The same page reserves the word specialisation for the integrated B.Des.-M.Des.; this tracker therefore labels these as B.Des. streams.

bachelor-of-management-studies.label: Management elective focus
bachelor-of-management-studies.summary: The public programme page describes specialised core and elective study but does not publish separate award-bearing specialisation options.

bs-business-dual-degree-with-asu.label: Partner concentration
bs-business-dual-degree-with-asu.summary: The official page identifies the dual-degree BS Business route and a Finance specialization at the partner stage. Partner rules and destination eligibility should be confirmed for the student's cohort.

bs-computer-science-dual-degree-with-asu.label: Dual-degree route
bs-computer-science-dual-degree-with-asu.summary: The public SNU page describes the BS Computer Science dual-degree route but does not publish a complete, credit-auditable concentration list. Use the ASU degree map for the destination cohort rather than treating interests as SNU credentials.
